study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting Heterogeneity in Functional Network Connectivity Aberrations in Antipsychotic Medication-Naïve First Episode Psychosis Patients - A Normative Modeling Study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Pretrained normative reference derived from ~22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan; single-site UAB case-control dataset (HC/patients) used in this study and for calibration.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We used data collected in a case-control study conducted at the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB)." "The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100). Healthy control data collected in this project were used for calibration of the normative reference curves"
